legend: We say that a sequence x1,x2,…,xn%%ZSMJ0%% is a step-function if there exist two distinct numbers A%%ZSMJ1%% and B%%ZSMJ2%% and some index 1<k≤n%%ZSMJ3%% such that xi=A%%ZSMJ4%% for i<k%%ZSMJ5%% and xi=B%%ZSMJ6%% for i≥k%%ZSMJ7%%.
Informally, a step-function is a sequence that changes value exactly once, so that it looks like [A,A,…,A,B,B,…,B]%%ZSMJ8%%.
For example, the sequences [1,1,1,3,3,3]%%ZSMJ9%%, [7,7,7,6]%%ZSMJ10%%, and [100,101,101]%%ZSMJ11%% are all step-functions, and the sequences [1,2,3]%%ZSMJ12%% and [0,0,0,0]%%ZSMJ13%% are not.

You are given an array a%%ZSMJ14%% of length n%%ZSMJ15%%. Your task is to find the length of the longest subsequence of a%%ZSMJ16%% that is a step-function. If there is no such subsequence, output 0%%ZSMJ17%%.

A sequence x%%ZSMJ18%% is a subsequence of another sequence y%%ZSMJ19%% if x%%ZSMJ20%% can be obtained by deleting several (possibly zero or all) elements from y%%ZSMJ21%%, without changing the order of the remaining elements. For example, [1,3,4,7]%%ZSMJ22%% is a subsequence of [1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8]%%ZSMJ23%%, and [3,3]%%ZSMJ24%% is a subsequence of itself, but [4,3]%%ZSMJ25%% is not a subsequence of [1,2,3,4]%%ZSMJ26%%.
input: Each test consists of multiple test cases.
The first line of input contains a single integer t%%ZSMJ27%% (1≤t≤104%%ZSMJ28%%) — the number of test cases.
The first line of each test case contains a single integer n%%ZSMJ29%% (1≤n≤105%%ZSMJ30%%)  – the length of the array a%%ZSMJ31%%.
The second line of each test case contains n%%ZSMJ32%% integers a1,…,an%%ZSMJ33%% (−109≤ai≤109%%ZSMJ34%%) — the values in the array a%%ZSMJ35%%.
It is guaranteed that the sum of n%%ZSMJ36%% over all test cases does not exceed 105%%ZSMJ37%%.
output: For each test case output a single integer  – the length of the longest subsequence of a%%ZSMJ38%% that is a step-function, or 0%%ZSMJ39%% of no such subsequence exists.
note: In the first test case, the longest step-function subsequence is [1,1,1,0,0,0]%%ZSMJ40%%.

In the second test case, the longest step-function subsequences are [6,6,6,7,7]%%ZSMJ41%% and [7,7,6,6,6]%%ZSMJ42%%. The subsequence [6,6,6,6,6,6]%%ZSMJ43%% is longer, but it is not a step-function subsequence because it does not contain two distinct values.
In the third test case, there are no step-function subsequences because there is only one distinct value in the array.
